title: pr-765432-onboard-aurora-pro-13b-v1.3-perf-metadata-changelog-automation
author: Marta Lopez
description: Onboard Aurora Pro 13B v1.3 into the model registry with curated performance profiles, updated metadata, and automated changelog/release notes generation. Motivation: v1.3 includes quantization-friendly weight layout changes and improved attention cache behavior that affect latency and memory profiles; we need updated perf profiles so infra can pick compatible kernels and customers see accurate cost/latency estimates. This PR includes: 1) metadata: model.json entry (architecture, tokenizer, recommended sequence lengths, quantization knobs, weight format version), 2) perf profiles: throughput/latency matrices across instance types (A100, H100, RTX6000), batching recommendations, and default KV cache policy, 3) changelog automation: hook that extracts perf profile summary and key metadata fields into the release notes template used by the model-registry CI job. Checklist: - [x] Add model metadata file and schema validation - [x] Add perf profiles for seq=128/512/2048 and typical batch sizes - [x] Add quantization recommendations and test vectors - [x] Wire changelog generator to model onboarding pipeline - [x] Add unit tests for metadata schema and changelog hook - [x] Add integration test against perf-matrix CI job Notes: Perf numbers are measured on internal perf-canary with stable kernel set; numbers include 95th p90 latencies and median throughput. Changelog hook captures model name, version, short description, perf highlights, and recommended deployment flags. See linked Linear tasks for rollout gating and QA.

ci_summary: All checks passed after a single re-run: unit tests green, perf-matrix job succeeded on canary infra, linting fixed by auto-formatter. Initial perf-matrix job had a transient failure due to tenant quota; rerun succeeded.
review_comments: Daniel Cho: Perf numbers look good overall; question on H100 2048 seq throughput - are we saturating memory bandwidth or kernel choices? Can we include a note about which kernel set was used for these measurements?

Marta Lopez: Answered - tests used kernel-set v3.7.2 (listed in perf_profiles header) and we included the kernel metadata in a comment. For H100/2048 the limiter was checkpoint memory; recommended default batch for H100 at seq=2048 is 1 for latency-sensitive workloads.
Priya Singh: Small nit - model.json schema requires 'supported_deployments' field for private installs. Please add a short list (hosted,dedicated,private).
Marta Lopez: Added supported_deployments and updated tests. Verified private install flag behavior in the integration test.
Marco Alvarez: Approve after tests - please squash commits and ensure release notes entry is generated as expected by the pipeline.
CI Bot: Integration test 'changelog-generator' passed on run #2 (environment: perf-canary).
release_notes:
- Onboarded Aurora Pro 13B v1.3: updated metadata and performance profiles.
- Performance highlights: A100: 40 tokens/s (seq=2048, batch=1 median throughput), H100: 55 tokens/s (seq=512, batch=2), RTX6000: 18 tokens/s (seq=512, batch=1).
- Changelog automation: model onboarding will emit a templated release note with perf highlights to streamline model registry updates.
notes_for_ops: Add kernel-set v3.7.2 to the compatible-kernels whitelist for onboarding; spin up perf-canary with the updated kernel-set before large-scale rollout.
how_to_verify: 1) Run tests/changelog/test_changelog_hook_integration.py locally; 2) Trigger CI job model-registry/perf-matrix and confirm numbers match perf_profiles; 3) Use tools/changelog-generator to produce release notes and validate template output matches expected fields.
